As a Delivery Driver at Albert Heijn, you ensure that customers receive their online grocery orders on time and with excellent service. You will be part of a friendly delivery team and serve as the face of Albert Heijn on the road and at customers' doorsteps. 
What you'll do: - Deliver Albert Heijn online grocery orders to customers. - Process payments when customers choose to pay upon delivery. - Provide excellent customer service and ensure customer satisfaction. - Represent Albert Heijn in a professional and friendly manner. 
Every day brings a new route and new customers, making this a varied and enjoyable role. You will work 4 to 6 days per week, with shifts scheduled based on your availability. A typical shift lasts approximately 6 to 7 hours. 
Shift Times: - Morning shift: Between 06:00 and 15:00 - Evening shift: Between 15:00 and 23:00 Over het bedrijf
